finding: Deferred EXISTS filters now have a narrow membership-cache fast path for single-table aliased equality checks.
evidence: The optimized path builds a HashSet for local alias.column values and evaluates outer probe expressions through membership lookup; unsupported EXISTS shapes fall back to evaluate_exists_subquery.
impact: Q14-style repeated `not exists(select * from sg y where y.link = ...)` checks avoid re-running the same local scan per candidate row.

finding: Aliased NOT EXISTS membership filtering is covered by regression.
impact: The fast path is guarded for the local-alias equality shape used by Q13/Q14 recursive CTE predicates.

finding: Full test-data non-isolation LDBC still times out with Q14 enabled after the membership-cache optimization.
evidence: summary status=gap; ldbc_command timed out after 180 seconds; workload status remained at Operations [4].
impact: Q14 remains the active performance frontier and needs deeper profiling or recursive expansion optimization before a full native pass is credible.

finding: The EXISTS membership cache did not regress PgWire integration behavior.
evidence: release pg_integration passed 27/27 after the change.
impact: The optimization is narrow enough to preserve JDBC/PgWire compatibility covered by existing integration tests.
